DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雨が強くなりましたね。お借りになったボールをお返しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The rain has gotten heavier. Are you returning the ball you borrowed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもと遊んでいましたが、今日は終わりにします。ボールが濡れてしまったので、そのまま返してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨で遊びを終え濡れた貸出ボールの返却方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I was playing with my child, but we're stopping for today. The ball got wet. Can I return it as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that rain ended your play and ask how to return the wet borrowed ball. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで状態を確認します。貸出札もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check its condition here. Do you also have the loan tag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 札はかばんに入れたはずです。ボールを持ったままだと探しにくいので、ここへ置いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貸出札を探すためボールを一時置いてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think I put the tag in my bag. It's hard to look for it while holding the ball. May I put it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may put the ball down temporarily to find the loan tag. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この箱へ置いてください。通路を空けてお探しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put it in this box. Keep the walkway clear while you look.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。札が見つかりました。子どもがまだ向こうの屋根で待っているので、返却後に迎えに行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 札を発見し屋根で待つ子どもを返却後に迎えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I found the tag. My child is still waiting under the roof over there, so I'll go get them after returning this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you found the tag and will collect your child waiting under the roof after returning the ball. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 札とボールを確認します。ほかに借りたものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the tag and ball. Did you borrow anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかにはありません。子どもの持っている小さいボールは家から持ってきたものです。そちらは持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貸出は一つで子どもの別のボールは自宅から持参と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, nothing else. The small ball my child has is one we brought from home. We'll take that one home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you borrowed only one item and brought your child's other ball from home. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 貸出は一つですね。返却を確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Just one borrowed item, then. I've confirmed the return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。子どもを迎えて帰ります。次に借りるときも、この札を受け取ってからでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却確認後に帰り次回の受付手順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll get my child and head home. Next time, should I receive this tag before borrowing again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After the return is confirmed, say you're heading home and ask about the procedure for next time. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 次回も受付で貸出の案内を確認してください。お帰りは足元にお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the borrowing instructions at reception next time too. Watch your step on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行の案内をご覧になっていましたね。どの列車をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking at the service information. Which train will you be taking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この通知で運転再開と見ました。でもホームの表示は遅延のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知と駅掲示が一致しないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This notification said services had resumed. But the platform display still says delayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because the notification and station notice do not match. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知の路線名を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the line name in the notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人から送られた画像です。あ、私が乗る線と名前が違います。自分の列車も再開したと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画像の対象線が違うと発見し誤認を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's an image a friend sent me. Oh, the name is different from the line I'm taking. I thought my train had resumed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice that the image concerns another line and correct your misunderstanding. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の路線の通知ですね。こちらの線は、現在この掲示の状況です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's a notification for another line. The current situation on this line is as shown on this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では友人の通知で判断せず、ここの案内を見ます。発車時刻はまだ決まっていないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自線掲示で判断し発車確定状況を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll use the information here instead of relying on my friend's notification. Has the departure time still not been decided?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Rely on your own line's notice and ask whether the departure time is confirmed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の時点では、確定した時刻をご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: At this point, we cannot give you a confirmed time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社には「再開した」と伝えてしまいました。訂正して、まだ発車時刻未定だと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社へ誤った再開情報を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I already told my workplace that services had resumed. I'll correct that and tell them the departure time is still undecided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct the mistaken resumption information you gave your workplace. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうなさってください。新しい情報が入りましたら、放送と掲示でお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. When new information arrives, we'll inform you through announcements and notices.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社へ訂正しました。友人にも路線が違ったと伝え、こちらの放送を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社と友人への訂正後自線放送を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've corrected what I told my workplace. I'll also tell my friend it was a different line and wait for announcements here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After correcting the information with your workplace and friend, wait for your line's announcement. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちの列車の路線名と行先を、次の案内でもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the line name and destination of the train you're waiting for in the next announcement too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の相談内容を確認します。お二人でお越しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me confirm what your appointment is about. Have you come together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。一つの予約で、私の保険のことと、家族の別の手続きを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一予約に別件二つを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Under one appointment, I'd like to discuss my insurance and a separate procedure for my family member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request two separate matters under one appointment. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ相談にお二人が参加するというご予約になっています。家族の方のご用件は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your booking is for two people attending the same consultation. What does your family member need help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族は住所の手続きです。付き添いではなく、それぞれ別の用件でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行ではなく家族の住所手続きが別件と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's an address procedure. They aren't just accompanying me; we each had a different matter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your family member's address procedure is a separate matter, rather than simply accompanying you. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住所の担当は別の窓口です。そちらの受付方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Address procedures are handled at another counter. I'll check how to register there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私はこの予約で保険の相談をします。家族がその間に住所の窓口へ行っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保険相談と住所窓口を別行動できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use this appointment for my insurance consultation. Can my family member go to the address counter meanwhile?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can attend the insurance consultation and address counter separately. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれご本人が説明できれば別々に受付できます。通訳が必要な場合は、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can register separately if each person can explain their own matter. Please let us know if you need an interpreter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族は私の通訳もする予定でした。先に私の相談に同席してから、住所の受付へ行く形にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通訳同席の必要から順序を調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family member was also going to interpret for me. I'd like them to join my consultation first and then register for the address procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Adjust the order because you need your family member present to interpret. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。住所の受付については、相談前に担当窓口へ確認しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Let's check with the relevant counter about address registration before your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約は私の保険の一件のままにします。家族の住所の用件は、別に受付方法を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約一件と住所の別受付を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please keep the appointment as just my insurance matter. Please check the registration procedure separately for my family member's address matter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm one appointment and separate registration for the address procedure. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でおつなぎします。お二人の用件を分けて担当者へ伝えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll refer you on that basis. I'll explain your two matters separately to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お支払いの書類について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about payment documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社で精算したいです。この会社の用紙に、病名と受診した日を書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社用紙に病名日付の記入を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to claim reimbursement at work. Could you fill in the diagnosis and consultation date on this company form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the diagnosis and date to be entered on your company's form. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受診日やお支払いの確認と、病名など医師の証明が必要な内容は別になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Confirmation of your consultation date or payment is separate from information such as a diagnosis that needs a doctor's certification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 領収書があれば全部証明できると思っていました。まず会社が必要としている項目を確認したほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 領収書と医師証明の範囲を理解し会社確認を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought a receipt could certify everything. I should first check which items my company needs, shouldn't I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the different scope of receipts and medical certification and decide to check with your company. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この用紙では医師の記入欄もあります。必要な書類の名称をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. This form also has a section for a doctor to fill in. Please check the name of the document required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今会社に聞きます。もし証明書が必要なら、この場で受付だけできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 証明書が必要な場合の受付を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask my company now. If I need a certificate, can I at least apply for it here today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about applying if a certificate is required. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容に応じて申込み方法をご案内します。すぐに作成できるかは確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain how to apply depending on the contents. We need to check whether it can be prepared immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社に確認できました。今は支払額と日付だけ必要で、病名の欄は使わないそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社が金額日付だけ求めると確認結果を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've checked with my company. For now, they only need the payment amount and date, and they say they won't use the diagnosis section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that your company confirmed it only needs the amount and date. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでしたら、まず領収書を会社へお見せください。病名の欄をこちらで推測して埋めることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: In that case, please show your company the receipt first. We won't guess a diagnosis to fill in that section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書を提出します。この用紙は会社で確認し、病名の記入はお願いしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書提出と不要な病名記入の撤回を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll submit the receipt. I'll check this form with my company and won't ask you to enter a diagnosis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will submit the receipt and withdraw the unnecessary request for a diagnosis entry. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。領収書はこちらです。ご自身でも保管方法を会社へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here is your receipt. Please also check with your company how you should keep it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 財布をなくされたとのことですね。最後に使った場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You lost your wallet, correct? Please tell me where you last used it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝、パンを買った店です。その後は触っていないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 店を最後の使用場所として相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At the shop where I bought bread this morning. I don't think I touched it afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the shop as the last place you used your wallet. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その後、どのように移動されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: How did you travel after that?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: バスのつもりでしたが、雨でタクシーに乗りました。いま乗車の履歴を見て思い出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 履歴を見てバスではなくタクシー移動を思い出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I intended to take the bus, but took a taxi because of the rain. Looking at my trip history just reminded me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Look at your trip history and recall taking a taxi rather than the bus. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: タクシーのお支払いは、何を使われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: How did you pay for the taxi?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現金でした。財布から出したので、店より後に車内で財布を使っています。最初の説明を直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金支払で最終使用を車内へ訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: With cash. I took it out of my wallet, so I used my wallet in the car after the shop. Please correct my initial account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the last use to inside the taxi because you paid cash. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後の使用は車内ですね。タクシー会社は記録で分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you last used it inside the taxi. Can you identify the taxi company from your records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社名と降りた時刻が分かります。ただ、降りる時に落とした場面は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社時刻は既知だが落下は未観察と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I know the company name and when I got out. But I didn't actually see it fall when I got out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you know the company and time but did not see the wallet fall. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実際に使ったことと、落とした可能性を分けて記録します。会社にも確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record your actual use separately from the possibility of dropping it. Will you check with the company too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この記録で会社へ問い合わせます。警察には車内で最後に使ったことと、その後会社まで歩いた経路を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: タクシー照会と警察への訂正経路報告を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use this record to contact the taxi company. I'll tell the police I last used it in the taxi and describe the route I walked to work afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to contact the taxi company and give the police the corrected account and route. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 最後に使った場所はタクシーの車内として記録します。乗車履歴も確認資料として担当へ渡しますので、会社への問い合わせ結果が分かりましたらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll record the inside of the taxi as the last place you used it. I'll also give the staff your trip history as supporting information, so please let us know when you have the result of your inquiry to the company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在通知について、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日は家にいたのに通知が入っていました。あとで呼鈴を試すと、音が鳴りませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 在宅時通知と呼鈴故障を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was home yesterday, but a notice was left. When I tested the doorbell later, it didn't ring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a missed-delivery notice while you were home and a faulty doorbell. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 呼鈴の状態が分かったのですね。通知の番号と宛名を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you've found out the state of the doorbell. I'll check the notice number and addressee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。私宛てです。配達の方が呼ばなかったとは分からないので、故障のことを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人宛通知を示し配達者行動は未確認と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. It's addressed to me. I don't know whether the delivery person didn't ring, so I want to report the fault.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the notice addressed to you and distinguish it from the unconfirmed actions of the delivery person. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その情報を配達担当へ伝えます。再配達を希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll pass that information to the delivery staff. Would you like redelivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 呼鈴はまだ直っていません。明日なら窓口で受け取れるので、受取可能な場所と条件を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 故障継続で翌日窓口受取の場所条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The doorbell hasn't been repaired yet. I can collect it at a counter tomorrow, so I'd like to know the available location and conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Because the fault remains, ask where and under what conditions you can collect it at a counter tomorrow. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 郵便物の種類と保管場所を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the type of mail and storage location and explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。管理会社にも修理を頼みます。受取に必要な書類は通知のどこを見ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理会社修理と本人確認書類の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll also ask the management company to repair it. Where on the notice should I look for the documents needed for collection?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for guidance on identification documents and mention requesting repairs from the management company. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内の欄をご覧ください。今回のお荷物について担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at this information section. The staff member will check the details for your package.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明日の窓口受取を相談し、必要な物を準備します。呼鈴の修理は管理会社へ頼み、配達担当へも故障を知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取準備と故障の配達担当共有を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll discuss collecting it at the counter tomorrow and prepare what I need. I'll ask the management company to repair the doorbell, and please also tell the delivery staff about the fault.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to prepare for collection and share the doorbell fault with delivery staff. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号と故障の情報を担当へ伝えます。受取の場所と条件が確認できるまで、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass the number and fault information to the staff member. Please wait here until we confirm the collection location and conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紛失されたカードは、利用停止の連絡をされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you contacted anyone to block the card you lost?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。停止は昨夜連絡しました。再発行は会社の人が全部やってくれると言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 停止済みと会社への再発行依頼を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I requested that it be blocked last night. Someone at work says they'll handle the entire replacement for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the card has been blocked and you asked someone at work to handle replacement. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様ご本人の口座ですね。会社の方に何をお願いしたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is your own account, correct? What did you ask the person at work to do?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日本語が難しいので、書類を書いてもらうつもりでした。署名も任せていいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類だけでなく署名も任せる思込みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Japanese is difficult for me, so I intended to have them fill in the documents. I thought I could leave the signature to them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your assumption that they could handle the signature as well as the documents. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 説明のお手伝いと、ご本人の署名や意思の確認は別です。必要な手続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Helping with explanations is separate from your own signature and confirmation of your wishes. We'll explain the necessary procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では会社の人には通訳を頼みます。私が内容を理解して、自分で署名します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通訳支援と本人署名を分けると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll ask the person at work to interpret. I'll understand the contents and sign myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to distinguish interpreting support from your own signature. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その形でご相談ください。再発行のご案内で、今分かりにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consult us on that basis. Is there anything in the replacement guidance you currently find unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受取方法の欄です。会社へ届くと決めつけず、自分の登録住所と案内を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社配送の思込みを避け登録住所と受取方法を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The section about receiving it. Instead of assuming it will be sent to my workplace, I'd like to check my registered address and the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid assuming workplace delivery and ask about your registered address and collection method. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。登録内容と今回選べる受取方法を確認して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. We'll check your registered information and the receipt methods available this time and explain them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 登録住所と受取方法を確認してから申込みます。会社には通訳だけをお願いし、私が決めると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 理解後本人が申込み会社支援の範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll apply after checking the registered address and receipt method. I'll ask work only for interpreting and explain that I will make the decisions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Apply yourself after understanding and explain the limits of workplace assistance. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご本人の確認書類を拝見し、案内を一つずつご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll look at your identification documents and explain the instructions one by one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品回収の案内をご覧になっていますね。お買い上げ品の確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the product recall notice. Would you like to check something you bought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家に同じ名前の商品があります。全部返したほうがいいのか、対象を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同名自宅商品が回収対象か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a product with the same name at home. I'd like to check which products are affected and whether I should return them all.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the same-named product at home is affected by the recall. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内には対象の記号が書かれています。お手元の包装で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This notice lists the affected codes. Can you check the packaging you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 商品の写真はありますが、裏の記号は写っていません。家族に包装を見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表写真のみで記号不足を認め家族へ包装確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a photo of the product, but it doesn't show the code on the back. I'll ask my family to look at the packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the front photo lacks the code and ask your family to check the packaging. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記号を読み上げてもらうか、写真で確認していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can ask them to read out the code or check it in a photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真が届きました。この部分です。案内の記号と最後の一文字が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届いた記号の一文字差を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The photo has arrived. It's this part. The last character is different from the code in the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the one-character difference in the code you received. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回の掲示の対象と一致しているか、担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check whether it matches the products covered by this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。文字が違うので絶対大丈夫とは、私から家族に言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 非一致だけで安全断定をせず担当確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I won't tell my family it's definitely fine just because the character is different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for staff confirmation without concluding it is safe solely because the code differs. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。掲示の対象の確認と、商品の安全についての個別のご心配は分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll handle checking coverage under the notice separately from your individual concerns about product safety.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 包装の記号で対象を確認してください。家族には、結果を聞くまではその包装を捨てずに残すよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 照合結果待ちで包装保持を家族へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please check whether it's affected using the packaging code. I'll tell my family to keep that packaging without throwing it away until we hear the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your family to retain the packaging while waiting for the matching result. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者を呼びます。掲示と、お持ちの記号の写真を一緒に見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll call the staff member. Please show them the notice and your photo of the code together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図でお探しの場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 軽く一周したいです。この数字が一周の距離なら、歩けそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 片道距離を一周と思って散歩希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like an easy walk around the circuit. If this number is the distance for one circuit, I think I can walk it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Express your wish for a walk, mistaking the one-way distance for a full circuit. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの数字は入口から展望広場までの片道です。一周の表示ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This number is the one-way distance from the entrance to the viewing plaza. It does not indicate a full circuit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰りの分も考える必要がありますね。今日は体力に自信がないので、長いコースは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 往復を理解し短いコースを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I need to account for the return journey too, then. I'm not confident in my stamina today, so I'd like to avoid a long route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the round trip and request a short route. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口に近い花壇の辺りで折り返す方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You could also turn back near the flowerbeds close to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 花壇まで行って同じ道を戻ります。坂があるか、地図のどこで分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花壇折返しを選び坂の読み方を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll go to the flowerbeds and return the same way. Where on the map can I see whether there are slopes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose to turn back at the flowerbeds and ask how to identify slopes. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この記号が坂です。花壇へはこの手前の道を使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This symbol indicates a slope. You can use this nearer path to the flowerbeds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この道ですね。同行者には長いコースを歩いてもらって、後で入口で合流できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 経路を確認し同行者との別歩行と合流を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: This path, right? Could my companion take the long route and meet me at the entrance afterward?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the route and discuss walking separately from your companion and meeting again. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待合せの場所と時刻は、お二人で決めておいてください。こちらの入口には案内板があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please agree on a meeting place and time between you. There is an information board at this entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 花壇で折り返し、案内板の前で合流すると連絡します。距離の数字だけで一周できるとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 短い往復と具体的な合流点を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell them I'm turning back at the flowerbeds and meeting in front of the information board. I won't judge whether I can complete a circuit from the distance number alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the short out-and-back walk and a specific meeting point. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご自身のペースでお進みください。疲れたら、早めに折り返してくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please walk at your own pace. If you get tired, turn back early.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機の操作でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble using the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分買いたいですが、この数字が人数なのか金額なのか分かりません。まだお金は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未投入で金額と人数の表示が不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy tickets for two, but I don't know whether this number is the number of people or the price. I haven't put any money in yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that no money has been inserted and that the price and passenger-count displays are unclear. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは金額の表示です。人数は別のボタンです。表示言語を変えてみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the price display. There is a separate button for the number of people. Would you like to change the display language?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。英語なら読めます。今の選択は一度戻して、最初から確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 英語表示と初期選択への復帰を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. I can read English. I'd like to undo the current selection and check from the beginning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request English display and a return to the initial selection. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入前なので戻せます。お二人は同じ行先でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can go back because you haven't purchased yet. Are you both going to the same destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中まで一緒ですが、友人は先の駅まで行きます。同じ切符を二枚では違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人の異なる行先を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: We're together partway, but my friend is going to a farther station. So two identical tickets wouldn't be right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the two of you have different destinations. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行先が違うので、一人ずつ選んで購入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Since your destinations differ, let's select and purchase for one person at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず私の行先を選びます。往復ではなく片道一人になっているか、支払う前に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自身の片道一人を支払前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll choose my destination first. Before I pay, could you check that it's one person, one way, rather than a round trip?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Have your one-way ticket for one person checked before paying. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この画面は片道一人です。行先もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: This screen shows one way for one person. Please also check the destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の行先も合っています。この一枚を買ってから、友人の行先を別に選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の一枚購入後友人分を別に買う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: My destination is correct too. After buying this ticket, I'll select my friend's destination separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy your own ticket first and then your friend's separately. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それではお支払いへお進みください。切符とおつりを取ってから、次の購入を始めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please proceed to payment. Take your ticket and change before starting the next purchase.
